# `reports/gadget_pkdgrav3_potential/make_boxsize_figures.py`

Source: [make_boxsize_figures.py](../../../../reports/gadget_pkdgrav3_potential/make_boxsize_figures.py)

```text
Finite-box effect on the halo potential statistics: the three matched-seed 512^3 production boxes
(L = 200, 500, 1000 Mpc/h, iSeed 12345678), top three mass bins x z = 0, 0.2, 0.5, compared with a linear-theory
estimate of the shift caused by the periodic box. Derivations: boxsize.tex.

usage: make_boxsize_figures.py [--d data/box512_L200_L500_L1000] [--figs figs] [--table boxsize_table.tex]
  data: L<box>_out<snap>_vprof_volume.npz (halo_potential_profile.py, volume weighting, pipeline stage vprof) and
        L<box>_out<snap>_xcorr_log.npz (halo_potential_xcorr.py, stage xcorr; per-region sums removed), copied from
        pawna:/user/shadab/sahyadri_scratch/halos/Sahyadri_L<box>N512/default512/r1/{vprof,xcorr}/
  boxsize_vprof.pdf      <phi>(r): measured (solid, jackknife band) and measured minus the shift (dashed)
  boxsize_vprof_dphi.pdf <phi>_L - <phi>_L1000 measured, and the predicted difference of the shifts
                         (Fourier mode sum, dashed; real-space integral-constraint estimate, dotted)
  boxsize_xcorr.pdf      structure function <(phi_i - phi_j)^2> of phi_Rvir, auto pairs, measured and corrected
  boxsize_xcorr_dsf.pdf  sf_L - sf_L1000 measured and predicted (Fourier, dashed; real-space bulk pull, dotted)
  boxsize_table.tex      shifts per box, bin and z (Fourier and real-space) and the measured box differences

Shift model: linear theory, P(k) = the CLASS P(k) of the ICs at z = 49 (scripts/pkdgrav3_pipeline/production/
cosmologies/default_class_pk_z49.dat) times the LCDM growth factor squared; halo bias from Tinker et al. (2010) at
the bin's mean mass (Delta = Bryan & Norman virial relative to the mean density); potential = peculiar, physical,
(km/s)^2, phi_k = -C delta_k / k^2 with C = 1.5 Om (100 km/s)^2 (1 + z) and k in h/Mpc.
```

## Contents

- [`growth`](#growth) - Linear growth factor D(a) of flat LCDM (Heath integral; D = a during matter domination).
- [`pk`](#pk) - Linear P(k) at redshift `z`: the tabulated z = 49 spectrum scaled by (D(z) / D(49))^2.
- [`cpot`](#cpot) - 4 pi G rho\_m a^2 for the physical peculiar potential, (km/s)^2 per (Mpc/h)^2
- [`sigma`](#sigma) - rms linear density contrast in a top-hat sphere of mass `M` (Msun/h) at redshift `z`.
- [`tinker_bias`](#tinker_bias) - Linear halo bias of Tinker et al. (2010) for mass `M` (Msun/h) at redshift `z`, with the halo overdensity Delta = Delta\_vir(z) / Omega\_m(z) relative to the mean density (Bryan &amp; Norman Delta\_vir).
- [`j0`](#j0) - Spherical Bessel function j0(x) = sin(x) / x.
- [`fourier_shift`](#fourier_shift) - [box mode sum - infinite integral] of int d^3k/(2pi)^3 P(k) k^-power j0(kr), at the radii r
- [`xi_lin`](#xi_lin) - linear xi(s) on s = 0.01..3000 Mpc/h
- [`realspace_vprof`](#realspace_vprof) - real-space estimate of the mean-potential shift (b = 1): shell theorem + integral constraint shift = C [ xbar R\_L^2 / 2 + int\_{R\_L}^inf xi(s) s ds ],  xbar = (3/R\_L^3) int\_0^R\_L xi s^2 ds
- [`bulk_pull`](#bulk_pull) - &lt;|g\_bar|^2&gt; of a sphere with the box volume in an infinite universe: the mean acceleration of the region, which (Newton's third law) is the pull of the matter outside it; the periodic box forces it to zero. &lt;g\_bar^2&gt; = C^2 int d^3k/(2pi)^3 P(k) W^2(kR) / k^2. Missing structure function ~ &lt;g\_bar^2&gt; r^2 / 3.
- [`vbulk`](#vbulk) - linear theory: peculiar velocity from the peculiar acceleration, v = f a H g / C (km/s)
- [`style`](#style) - Common axis style of the report figures (white background, light grid, no top/right spines).
- [`load_all`](#load_all) - Load the stacked potential (vprof) and potential cross-correlation (xcorr) results of every box and snapshot from `d`; returns a dict keyed by (L, z, mass bin) with r, values, errors and predictions.
- [`grid`](#grid) - 3 x 3 figure (rows: snapshots, columns: mass bins) with shared x axes and a title.
- [`fig_profiles`](#fig_profiles) - Figure of the measured profiles per box (`what` = 'vprof': stacked potential; 'xcorr': structure function) with the measured-minus-predicted box-size shift; saved to `out`.
- [`fig_diff`](#fig_diff) - Figure of the box-size difference relative to L = 1000 against the predictions (Fourier mode sum and real-space integral constraint); saved to `out`.
- [`table`](#table) - LaTeX table of the box-size shifts, measured against predicted, per snapshot, mass bin and box.
- [`main`](#main) - Command line: make the box-size figures and table from the reduced data (`--d`, `--figs`, `--table`).

real-space estimate of the mean-potential shift (b = 1): shell theorem + integral constraint

## bulk_pull

```python

```

&lt;|g\_bar|^2&gt; of a sphere with the box volume in an infinite universe: the mean acceleration of the region,
which (Newton's third law) is the pull of the matter outside it; the periodic box forces it to zero.
&lt;g\_bar^2&gt; = C^2 int d^3k/(2pi)^3 P(k) W^2(kR) / k^2. Missing structure function ~ &lt;g\_bar^2&gt; r^2 / 3.
